Project Overview

A new lifestyle and retail brand has approached you to help them assess data related to buying patterns in different countries. They are in an expansion mode and would like to present some findings to their investment board regarding the pros and cons related to some key products that they carry. They are also interested also in understanding perspectives from travelers in specified countries to enhance their understanding of how to approach a key segment of their market, vacationers

## 1  We came here with some of our friends and our baby. The staff was very nice to all of us. They spoke Italian and English which made things easier for us. We came back late one night from taking the train to Florence and we asked the staff if the restaurant was still open. They called the chef and had him come in to make a dish for us that wasn't even on the menu! The bar had a wide variety of drinks to choose from also. The bedroom was very clean and neat! We had a balcony with tables and chairs so we could sit outside. The Air Conditioning was AMAZING I haven't experienced a/c like this anywhere else in Italy! The Residence San Rossore was close to Pisa we brought our car and it was only like a 5 min drive. Overall we had a great time but the only problem we had was that we had to pay 5$ per person for the pool. I would definitely visit this place again next time I come back!! 
## 2                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             5 min drive out of Pisa or you need to catch the Bus, too far to walk.Beautiful self-contained apartments, well appointed with plenty of space, very clean.Great pool area with spa and massage area downstairs.
## 3                                                                                                                                            My family of 5 stayed at the residence San Rossore for 8 nights. We had a great time mainly due to the pool, friendliness of the staff, and a good base for exploring. (The attractions in Pisa, Lucca, Florence, and the Beach)The villas are huge and very functional which is a key requirement for a young family. The kitchen mainly comprises of a hob and a fridge so is fairly basic. We tendered to eat out most nights so this wasn't a problem but when staying in had no problem with cooking pasta from the local 'deli'. The apartment only has Italian TV therefore those travelling with kids may wish to bring a Dvd player or laptop for their evening entertainment. The Italian breakfast served in the bar area was a tasty and leisurely start to each day.
## 4                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           We stayed here for a couple of nights on the way down to Tuscany &amp; needed somewhere that was clean &amp; had a pool.There seem to be very few hotels in or around Pisa that have pools &amp; are reasonably priced. This fits both bills. The apartment was clean, and there was a bar in the hotel itself to get drinks, snacks &amp; a well priced breakfast at 5 euros per person (croissant, coffee, juice &amp; cereal).It had wi-fi which was 5 euro per 24 hours.It also had parking &amp; was well situated to visit Pisa &amp; the coast.All in all, it was basic, but perfect for an overnight stay.

## 11                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           The accomodation was simple but more than adequate. Spotlessly clean and very spacious. pool area was very pleasant - the highlight was the level of service. Thanks to Petra for sorting out a mix-up with the booking and letting us check out in the afternoon on the day we left. Great ceentre for exploring Pisa and the surrounding areas.
## 12                                                                                                                                                                                                                  We booked this accomodation with a group of six people for our stay in Pisa during a conference. Although the accomodation was quite far from the city centre and the conference center, it was easy to get there by bus (only 1 euro) or taxi. Petra was quite happy to help you arrange a taxi or provide you with any tourist information. She was very friendly and helpful, always smiling and really gave us a pleasant and welcome stay at the residence. We enjoyed having to opportunity to have a quick dive in the swimming pool at the end of our day before going out for dinner. The appartment was clean and spacious. As we did not have a car, the supermarket was quite a bit of a walk.
## 13                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         Escape the hoards of tourists in the centre and give yourself a bit of space, and a pool, by staying in an apartment at San Rossore. The 2 bed apartment we had was well equipped, spacious and light. Furnished in a minimal white style with one double and one twin room it met all our needs. The outdoor pool is large enough and provided a welcome place to relax and cool off. Minor niggles with the pillows (only one and quite thin) and no towel for the kitchen, but everything else excellent. Friendly reception team. Only a short drive (around 1.5km) to the leaning tower, walkable if it's not stiflingly hot.

## 15                                                                                                                                                                                                                      The Hostel is in a pretty good location, about a 15 min walk from the airport and the directions were pretty good. and then about a 10 min walk to the Tower and only a 2 min walk to the train station. The Room wasnt the best, we stayed in a female dorm on the ground floor and didn't seem very secure, the room door didn't have a lock and the front door of the hostel was open all the time. The room had a locker for everyone, however the one we were allocated didnt lock. Not the cleanist place, I got bed bugs here. The bathrooms werent the best either, there was 2 dorms on the ground floor and only 2 bathrooms. There was no water pressure at all, had to have a cold shower.
## 16         While travelling around, I spend one night in Station Pisa hostel with 3 friends.The 4-bed room we had booked was clean but really simple and the beds were 2 bunkbeds, no problem for us but might be a problem for other age groups. The bathroom was shared with another room but clean as well. It's location is perfect, between the airport and the centre, on the other hand Pisa is a rather small city, so everything is in walking distance. As far as I saw, most people in the hostel were young travellers, which is also the age group I would recommend this hostel to. The receptionists were nice and helpful with everything we needed. For the price of 50 euro/night for a room for 4 people, it was more than expected. However, I wouldn't recommend it for people who want to travel with luxury, just for the ones who need a simple, cheap, clean and convieniently located place to stay.

## 108  No elevator, we did not get any help to carry our heavy bags upstairs. We did not get advice from the reception of how to use the lights in the room and we asked the cleaner who was helpful. The staff at the reception did not smile or talk much. The lady though gave us advise how to go the tourist information center and recommended a bus than a train to go to Viareggio because of a train accident.The breakfast was okey with also cheese and ham. There was a TV in the breakfast room.The colours in the hotel were terrible orange, green.. The room was small. There was no noise of traffic to our room, so we could sleep quite well. The bathroom was terrible. When it got wet, the smell was awful... There is mould.Location is close to railway station. There is an afro-asian shop in the same street but also an elegant wine shop. I do not know if the area is safe late at night. It was easy to reach the hotel when we came from Florence by train. We also took a train to the Pisa airport when leaving. There were only three passengers in the morning. We did not see any taxis at the taxi station.We walked to the Pisa tower, but there are also buses. In tourist information they guided us a nice way to walk there. There is not a long way to a shopping street from the hotel and there were also some restaurants some steps away.From a bus station we bought tickets to Viareggio beach resort. The bus stop was not far from our hotel. The buses were full of beach vendors when we came back and the bus was very hot. So, do not wait until the last bus. Luckily the driver opened the door while driving.

## 1056                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              The NH is a nice hotel, just across the street from the train station. ## 1143                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  My wife and I stayed at Claudia's place for 4 days, and we had a wonderfull time.  She took the time to pick us up at the airport, and also drop us again when leaving.  She and her daughter took care of us, and made us feel as if we were visiting family. ## 465                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Check-in was swift, there was a short queue and we were checked in very quickly. We came earlier than the check-in time initially, the hotel was happy to keep our bags. The room, although small, which is often the case in cities, was clean &amp; the bed was comfortable. The bathroom was equipped with the all usual amenities and it was clean as well. Our room included breakfast and we found the selection of fruits, cold cuts, cheeses, pastries, scambled egg, bacon, fresh juices &amp; coffee plentiful and fresh. The location was very accessible to the nearby train station &amp; taxi rank (across the road) as well as shops, restaurants and of course the leaning tower of Pisa (10-15 minute walk!). The hotel was €10-11 taxi ride from the Airport. We would highly recommend this hotel to fellow travellers.
## 590                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Booked with a flight through BA.Three nights bed and breakfast.Big comfy bed, but standard rooms are a bit cosy. The hotel overlooks the train station and bus stops, but the extra glazing keeps all of the noise out.Plenty of storage space plus a safe and minibar. There's even a kettle, which doesn't seem to be a standard feature in Italy.Bathroom was compact but had everything: good size bath, rainfall shower, WC and bidet.Breakfast was good, standard continental with pastries, fruit, cheeses and meats, plus some cooked bacon and scrambled egg. Great coffee from the machine too.Taxi from the airport was less than ten euro, but the bus and train are also quick and easy...and cheap.The hotel is about as far as you can get from the Tower, but the walk is pleasant enough through town. But If you're going to take a trip into Florence, then you couldn't be better for the train.
## 1266 My family and I stayed here for a 3 day visit to Pisa. We absolutely loved it aside from the fact that there was no AC (but we were aware of this when we booked it so we can't complain too much). The owners are complete darlings. Simone is incredibly helpful. Don't be surprised if you wake up at 2am to use the bathroom and he is in his office working away. I like that he is always popping in throughout the day and night to either work or just to keep an eye on things. We found the house to be very clean. The kitchen is really nice and has everything you need to make a good meal. I was a bit worried that there was only 1 bathroom but it worked out even with 7 people staying there. We are supplied towels and a space to keep your things in the bathroom. Simone also helped my brother find a garage to have his car fixed while we were there. I found him to be incredibly hospitable. I saw another review about the house being unclean and I find that laughable. The house was spotless. We also got lost on our way to Pisa and had to keep calling him to say we'd be late and he stuck around waiting for us. With a few tweaks (mainly acquiring AC) this place could be a top spot to stay while in Pisa.

Lovely coffee made to order and delivered to you table by friendly staff.The guy on the desk was most helpful, giving restaurant tips and directions.This is my second visit and will no doubt be going again. Wordclouds

The Bahamas

#Get reviews for wordclouds
baha_rev <- baha$ReviewText

#Convert to corpus and convert to lowercase
btext <- Corpus(VectorSource(baha_rev))
btext <- tm_map(btext, content_transformer(tolower))
## Warning in tm_map.SimpleCorpus(btext, content_transformer(tolower)):
## transformation drops documents
#Remove stopwords
btext <- tm_map(btext, removeWords, c(stopwords("english"), "and", "or","hotel"))
## Warning in tm_map.SimpleCorpus(btext, removeWords, c(stopwords("english"), :
## transformation drops documents
#Create wordcloud
btext.dtm <- TermDocumentMatrix(btext)

btext.matrix <- as.matrix(btext.dtm)

bwords <- sort(rowSums(btext.matrix), decreasing=TRUE)

btext.df <- data.frame(word = names(bwords),freq=bwords)
wordcloud2(data=btext.df, size = 0.20, shape="ellipse")

#Convert to corpus and convert to lowercase
ttext <- Corpus(VectorSource(trini_rev))
ttext <- tm_map(ttext, content_transformer(tolower))
## Warning in tm_map.SimpleCorpus(ttext, content_transformer(tolower)):
## transformation drops documents
#Remove stopwords
ttext <- tm_map(ttext, removeWords, c(stopwords("english"), "and", "or","hotel"))
## Warning in tm_map.SimpleCorpus(ttext, removeWords, c(stopwords("english"), :
## transformation drops documents
#Create wordcloud
ttext.dtm <- TermDocumentMatrix(ttext)

ttext.matrix <- as.matrix(ttext.dtm)

twords <- sort(rowSums(ttext.matrix), decreasing=TRUE)

ttext.df <- data.frame(word = names(twords),freq=twords)
wordcloud2(data=ttext.df, size = 0.20, shape="ellipse")

Wordcloud Comparisons

Based on the word clouds, it is apparent that most reviews for Jamaica and Trinidad and Tobego are about the hotel room, since the largest word in their wordclouds is “room”. On the other hand, most reviews in the Bahamas discuss “breakfast”

## 108  No elevator, we did not get any help to carry our heavy bags upstairs. We did not get advice from the reception of how to use the lights in the room and we asked the cleaner who was helpful. The staff at the reception did not smile or talk much. The lady though gave us advise how to go the tourist information center and recommended a bus than a train to go to Viareggio because of a train accident.The breakfast was okey with also cheese and ham. There was a TV in the breakfast room.The colours in the hotel were terrible orange, green.. The room was small. There was no noise of traffic to our room, so we could sleep quite well. The bathroom was terrible. When it got wet, the smell was awful... There is mould.Location is close to railway station. There is an afro-asian shop in the same street but also an elegant wine shop. I do not know if the area is safe late at night. It was easy to reach the hotel when we came from Florence by train. We also took a train to the Pisa airport when leaving. There were only three passengers in the morning. We did not see any taxis at the taxi station.We walked to the Pisa tower, but there are also buses. In tourist information they guided us a nice way to walk there. There is not a long way to a shopping street from the hotel and there were also some restaurants some steps away.From a bus station we bought tickets to Viareggio beach resort. The bus stop was not far from our hotel. The buses were full of beach vendors when we came back and the bus was very hot. So, do not wait until the last bus. Luckily the driver opened the door while driving.
## 211                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         This certainly isn't the most posh hotel in Italy, but it's conveniently located across from the train station, clean, and fine for a night.  The rooms are fairly bare-bones but clean.  The breakfast buffet is decent.  The location can't be beat, the staff is helpful and the price is reasonable.  Not an extended stay kind of place, but fine for a night or two.
## 532                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             Can't complainp about this hotel... Rooms were always very clean and tidy, staff was friendly and polite...their level of English was very good. Centrtally located; 5 minutes away by bus from the airport and situated in front of the train station; 20 minutes walk to the Leaning Tower which is not far at all and to top it all off, there are loads of shops on the way to Piazza dei Miracoli... Will definitely visit again.
## 1056                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              The NH is a nice hotel, just across the street from the train station. It was our first of thirty four days in Italy.What has me writing this review is the breakfast at the NH.  Good fresh fruit , pastries  and foccachia pizzas, three different Italian cheeses /cured meats. What I will remember is the tasty potatoes, perfect cooked scrambled eggs from a buffet mind you. Now the bacon.  It was the best I ever had in my life.  The bacon was not browned at all, not American syle crispy bacon but soft and delicious with a velvet texture. Delicious. This was the first and last hearty breakfast I had in Italy. 
## 1143                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  My wife and I stayed at Claudia's place for 4 days, and we had a wonderfull time.  She took the time to pick us up at the airport, and also drop us again when leaving.  She and her daughter took care of us, and made us feel as if we were visiting family.  The personal touch they give while you stay there is wonderful.  Claudia was always open for a conversation, and yet she kept her distance so you still have your privacy.  For breakfast she always baked new cookies/cakes, we got fresh fruit every morning and some bread with local meat.  On top of that a great smile, and every day started out perfect.  :-)  If we ever were to visit Pisa again, I'ld definitly go to Claudia again, and we can really recommend this place to anyone who likes a warm home.  If you need info about the location and distances, you can easily figure it out online.  Distance to the leaning tower and railroad are easily to be done by foot, if you don't mind a 30min walk.  It's the perfect way to visit Pisa!

## 1161 We stayed at Claudia Ferri's for one night. ## 465                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Check-in was swift, there was a short queue and we were checked in very quickly. We came earlier than the check-in time initially, the hotel was happy to keep our bags. The room, although small, which is often the case in cities, was clean &amp; the bed was comfortable. The bathroom was equipped with the all usual amenities and it was clean as well. Our room included breakfast and we found the selection of fruits, cold cuts, cheeses, pastries, scambled egg, bacon, fresh juices &amp; coffee plentiful and fresh. The location was very accessible to the nearby train station &amp; taxi rank (across the road) as well as shops, restaurants and of course the leaning tower of Pisa (10-15 minute walk!). The hotel was €10-11 taxi ride from the Airport. We would highly recommend this hotel to fellow travellers.
## 590                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Booked with a flight through BA.Three nights bed and breakfast.Big comfy bed, but standard rooms are a bit cosy. The hotel overlooks the train station and bus stops, but the extra glazing keeps all of the noise out.Plenty of storage space plus a safe and minibar. There's even a kettle, which doesn't seem to be a standard feature in Italy.Bathroom was compact but had everything: good size bath, rainfall shower, WC and bidet.Breakfast was good, standard continental with pastries, fruit, cheeses and meats, plus some cooked bacon and scrambled egg. Great coffee from the machine too.Taxi from the airport was less than ten euro, but the bus and train are also quick and easy...and cheap.The hotel is about as far as you can get from the Tower, but the walk is pleasant enough through town. But If you're going to take a trip into Florence, then you couldn't be better for the train.
## 1266 My family and I stayed here for a 3 day visit to Pisa. #———————– Using predictions we predict if the Sales.Channel based on the country and item type

fixedCountries$Sales.Channel <- tolower(fixedCountries$Sales.Channel)

fixedCountries$Sales.Channel <- ifelse(fixedCountries$Sales.Channel %in% c("yes", ""), NA, fixedCountries$Sales.Channel)

fixedCountries$Sales.Channel <- factor(fixedCountries$Sales.Channel, levels = c("offline", "online"))

print(table(fixedCountries$Sales.Channel, useNA = "always"))
## 
## offline  online    <NA> 
##    9278    9081      80
train_data <- fixedCountries %>% filter(!is.na(Sales.Channel))

if (length(unique(train_data$Sales.Channel)) > 1) {
    model <- glm(Sales.Channel ~ Country + X, data = train_data, family = binomial, na.action = na.exclude)

    missing_indices <- which(is.na(fixedCountries$Sales.Channel))
    fixedCountries$PredictedProb <- predict(model, newdata = fixedCountries, type = "response")

    fixedCountries$Sales.Channel[missing_indices] <- ifelse(fixedCountries$PredictedProb[missing_indices] > 0.5, "online", "offline")

    fixedCountries$Sales.Channel <- factor(fixedCountries$Sales.Channel, levels = c("offline", "online"))

    fixedCountries <- fixedCountries %>% select(-PredictedProb)
} else {
    warning("Not enough unique levels in Sales.Channel to fit the model. Check data cleaning steps!")
}

print(table(fixedCountries$Sales.Channel, useNA = "always"))

## offline  online    <NA>

#————————– It was noticed that Unit.Cost only relates to one type of item. Using this we are able to look at the price # to figure out the X eg 117.11 is only related to cereal

cost_to_product <- fixedCountries %>%
  filter(X != "None" & !is.na(X) & X != "") %>%
  group_by(Unit.Cost) %>%
  summarize(
    potential_product = first(X), 
    product_count = n_distinct(X)  
  ) %>%
  filter(product_count == 1) 

fixedCountries <- fixedCountries %>%
  left_join(cost_to_product, by = "Unit.Cost") %>%
  mutate(
    X = case_when(
      X == "None" & !is.na(potential_product) ~ potential_product,
      TRUE ~ X
    )
  ) %>%
  select(-potential_product, -product_count) 


fixedCountries <- fixedCountries %>%
  mutate(X = ifelse(X == "None", "Other", X))
summary(fixedCountries$X)

What is the average amount spent on Personal Care vs. Cosmetics in each region?

#Clean up data

#options(scipen=9999)

sales.df = cleanData.df


#Convert Revenue to numeric
sales.df$Total.Revenue <- as.numeric(sales.df$Total.Revenue)

#Create dataframes for Personal Care and Cosmetics
caredata <- subset(sales.df, X == "Personal Care")


cosmeticsdata <- subset(sales.df, X == "Cosmetics")


careavg <- mean(caredata$Total.Revenue, na.rm = TRUE)
cosmeticsavg <- mean(cosmeticsdata$Total.Revenue, na.rm = TRUE)

In which country do people use the most cosmetics?

#Convert Revenue to numeric
cosmeticsdata$Units.Sold <- as.numeric(cosmeticsdata$Units.Sold)

cat("People use the most cosmetics in", cosmax$Country)

In 2016, which product had the highest and lowest quantity sold across each region?

  data.frame(

})

In which of the seasons (Spring, Summer, Autumn, Winter) do people spend the most on:

Cosmetics Personal Care

#Note that we will use the same seasons for all regions, and assume typical Northern Hemisphere Seasons where, generally
#Winter is December, January and February
#Spring is March, April and May
#Summer is June, July and August
#Autumn is September, October, November

#Set datatypes
sales.df$Month <- as.numeric(format(sales.df$Order.Date, "%m"))

#Create bins labelled as seasons, and assign months to seasons
sales.df$Season <- cut(sales.df$Month,
                       breaks = c(0, 2, 5, 8, 11, 12),
                       labels = c("Winter", "Spring", "Summer", "Autumn", "Winter"),
                       include.lowest = TRUE, right = TRUE)

#Create an aggregate of revenue by season
seasonsales <- aggregate(Total.Revenue ~ Season + X, data = sales.df[sales.df$X %in% c("Cosmetics", "Personal Care"), ], sum, na.rm = TRUE)


#Set datatypes
seasonsales$Season <- as.character(seasonsales$Season)

#Get maximums
maxcos <- seasonsales$Season[which.max(seasonsales$Total.Revenue[seasonsales$X == "Cosmetics"])]
maxcare <- seasonsales$Season[which.max(seasonsales$Total.Revenue[seasonsales$X == "Personal Care"])]

cat("Highest spending on cosmetics was in", maxcos, "and highest spending on personal care was in", maxcare)
## Highest spending on cosmetics was in Winter and highest spending on personal care was in Winter

Based on correlation from part (g), build a predictive model that can be used to predict Total.Profit. Determine the accuracy of the model and show the result of a sample set of predictions for data not included in the given dataset.

#Split data into training and testing
set.seed(101)
train <- (sample(1:nrow(sales.df),nrow(sales.df)*0.8))
training <- sales.df[train,]
testing <- sales.df[-train,]

#Model
result <- result <- lm(Total.Profit ~ Units.Sold + Unit.Price + Unit.Cost + Total.Revenue + Total.Cost, data = sales.df)
summary(result)
## 
## Call:
## lm(formula = Total.Profit ~ Units.Sold + Unit.Price + Unit.Cost + 
##     Total.Revenue + Total.Cost, data = sales.df)
## 
## Residuals:
##            Min             1Q         Median             3Q            Max 
## -0.00000071812 -0.00000000017 -0.00000000006  0.00000000007  0.00000109589 
## 
## Coefficients:
##                             Estimate             Std. Error
## (Intercept)   -0.0000000049278112711  0.0000000002657449604
## Units.Sold     0.0000000000012684093  0.0000000000000464926
## Unit.Price     0.0000000000738390077  0.0000000000041047523
## Unit.Cost     -0.0000000000592908274  0.0000000000050681659
## Total.Revenue  0.9999999999999903411  0.0000000000000007139
## Total.Cost    -0.9999999999999882316  0.0000000000000008807
##                            t value            Pr(>|t|)    
## (Intercept)                 -18.54 <0.0000000000000002 ***
## Units.Sold                   27.28 <0.0000000000000002 ***
## Unit.Price                   17.99 <0.0000000000000002 ***
## Unit.Cost                   -11.70 <0.0000000000000002 ***
## Total.Revenue  1400848579289693.50 <0.0000000000000002 ***
## Total.Cost    -1135453013174722.50 <0.0000000000000002 ***
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
## 
## Residual standard error: 0.00000001005 on 18433 degrees of freedom
## Multiple R-squared:      1,  Adjusted R-squared:      1 
## F-statistic: 5.217e+30 on 5 and 18433 DF,  p-value: < 0.00000000000000022
#Accuracy
testing$predictions <- as.integer(predict(result,testing))
sum(ifelse(abs(testing$Total.Profit-testing$predictions)<=5,1,0))/nrow(testing)*100
## [1] 100

Explain how this model may help the investors make better decisions.

Investors could use this model to predict profits. This is especially useful when deciding how much of a product should be purchased, and how that may translate to future profits
